findingChanges.title: Smith bar is disconnected from its rails

findingChanges.title: Landmine bar changes length
findingChanges.change: Landmine hand/load targets lie on a fixed-radius sphere about the anchored base; shaft and load stay rigid.

findingChanges.title: Cable does not connect to the depicted station
findingChanges.change: Rebuilt cable posts, working pulleys, return cables and stacks at the exercise-specific attachment height and direction.

findingChanges.title: Machine arms telescope instead of pivoting
findingChanges.change: Machine handles follow fixed-radius pivot arcs, with fixed-length arms and resistance plates.

findingChanges.title: Loaded hands do not wrap around the equipment
findingChanges.change: Reoriented wrists along the forearm, closed loaded fingers and fitted rigid-handle palm targets. Fine skin/finger collision is still outside the numerical check.

findingChanges.title: Floor or bench support through the hands is missing
findingChanges.change: Added explicit palm/forearm support modes and fitted bench, floor, wall and ball support targets.

findingChanges.title: Suspension setup is not mechanically constrained
findingChanges.change: Added fixed-length adjusted straps, anchor beam, hand grips and foot cradles; reworked rows and foot-supported body lines.

findingChanges.title: Incline bench tilts opposite to the body
findingChanges.change: Incline backrest now slopes with the supported trunk and includes a separate seat.

findingChanges.title: Overhead press starts with a collapsed rack
findingChanges.change: Shoulder presses use a shoulder-height rack and a reachable overhead path.

findingChanges.title: Kettlebell shape is not fitted to the loaded wrist
findingChanges.change: Kettlebell handle/body remain one rigid assembly; rack, overhead, bottoms-up and swing orientations are distinct.

findingChanges.title: Two kettlebells replace the two-hand swing
findingChanges.change: Two-hand swing uses one shared bell.

findingChanges.title: Hack squat lacks its defining machine
findingChanges.change: Added hack-squat rails, moving back/shoulder pads, handles and footplate.

findingChanges.title: Leg-press feet move through a static footplate
findingChanges.change: Leg-press feet and angled footplate move together on a sled, with a separate supported seat/backrest.

findingChanges.title: Machine support and linkage are incomplete
findingChanges.change: Added fitted pads/restraints, fixed knee pivots and hip-machine swing arms/foot supports; generic mechanism illustrations are not manufacturer CAD replicas.

findingChanges.title: Glute-ham raise uses a floor Nordic setup
findingChanges.change: Raised the glute-ham setup onto its knee pad, footplate and ankle restraints.

findingChanges.title: Standing calf machine has no shoulder load or step
findingChanges.change: Added a forefoot platform and moving loaded shoulder pads.

findingChanges.title: Inverted row depicts suspension equipment
findingChanges.change: Replaced suspension equipment with a fixed inverted-row bar and reworked the body line.

findingChanges.title: Neutral pull-up lacks neutral handles
findingChanges.change: Added parallel neutral-grip pull-up handles.

findingChanges.title: Pulldown and rope attachments do not match the movement
findingChanges.change: Added split ropes, end stops, centre pulldown bars, thigh restraints and fitted cable grips.

findingChanges.title: Preacher or concentration support is misplaced
findingChanges.change: Fitted preacher upper-arm support and concentration-curl elbow/inner-thigh setup.

findingChanges.title: Barbell rollout is drawn as an ab wheel
findingChanges.change: Barbell rollout now uses a shaft and two rolling plates.

findingChanges.title: Ab wheel floats above the floor
findingChanges.change: Rollout axle is at the actual rolling radius above the floor.

findingChanges.title: Supine support is lost
findingChanges.change: Reworked supine targets and head/back support. The shared skin remains a simplified illustration.

findingChanges.title: Hip thrust does not keep the upper back on the bench
findingChanges.change: Upper back/head stay at the hip-thrust bench; pelvis moves through hip extension instead of lifting the entire back off the support.

findingChanges.title: Squeeze bridge places the ball under the feet
findingChanges.change: Small squeeze ball is between the knees, with feet supported on the floor.

findingChanges.title: Decline sit-up has a flat unrestrained bench
findingChanges.change: Added a sloped decline pad and ankle restraint with a matching supported trunk setup.

findingChanges.title: Load or grip does not match the intended implement
findingChanges.change: Fitted single shared dumbbells, hip-load cushion, rim/pinch plate setups and intended kettlebell variants.

findingChanges.title: Raised rear foot misses its support
findingChanges.change: Rear-foot bench/box now occupies the actual raised-foot support position.

findingChanges.title: Decline push-up box is under the hands
findingChanges.change: Moved decline push-up support under the feet and reworked the loaded body line.

findingChanges.title: Walking/reverse lunge lacks its step sequence
findingChanges.change: Added the reverse/walking lunge step/recovery path. These are stationary looping illustrations, not a locomotion simulation.

findingChanges.title: Depth jump starts on the floor
findingChanges.change: Depth jump begins on its box, drops to the floor and rebounds.

findingChanges.title: Lateral box placement disagrees with the jump
findingChanges.change: Lateral landing box now lies along the lateral travel path.

findingChanges.title: BOSU hand or forearm support is misplaced
findingChanges.change: BOSU support follows the selected hand/forearm setup; feet-on-top squat jumps remain on that platform.

findingChanges.title: Side-lying straight-leg raise bends the knee
findingChanges.change: Side-lying abduction now follows a long-leg arc.

findingChanges.title: Hip airplane is only a single-leg hinge
findingChanges.change: Hip airplane includes controlled opening/closing of the pelvis/trunk.

findingChanges.title: Wall or post contact is absent
findingChanges.change: Added visible wall/contact panels and support posts; panels are translucent so the body can be inspected.

findingChanges.title: Pass-through has no towel or stick
findingChanges.change: Added the pass-through stick between the hands.

findingChanges.title: Inchworm lacks hand walking
findingChanges.change: Inchworm alternates hand reaches into/out of a connected plank line.

findingChanges.title: Push-up-to-downward-dog omits the push-up
findingChanges.change: Separated the push-up phase from the subsequent downward-dog phase.

findingChanges.title: Scapular push-up uses body lift rather than scapular action
findingChanges.change: Scapular push-up uses a small shoulder-girdle reach with the supporting body line held.

findingChanges.title: Open book does not retain a stacked side-lying base
findingChanges.change: Reworked stacked side-lying legs and thoracic opening while retaining the pelvis base.

findingChanges.title: Stretch grip or support is missing
findingChanges.change: Fitted quad-stretch ankle grasp, triceps/wrist stretch hand targets and stable free-hand supports.

findingChanges.title: Sled hands and equipment do not move coherently
findingChanges.change: Fitted sled-post palm contacts and pull straps to the body/step loop.

findingChanges.title: Shadow boxing loses the guard and wrist line
findingChanges.change: Added fists, alternating punches and a retained guard with aligned wrists.

findingChanges.title: Farmer carry curls the arms
findingChanges.change: Farmer-carry hands hang at the sides instead of remaining curled.

findingChanges.title: Front rack carry lacks a rack
findingChanges.change: Front-rack carry uses the supported rack and appropriate bell placement.

findingChanges.title: Deadlift bottom does not reach the ground
findingChanges.change: Conventional/sumo bar setup now reaches the plate-supported floor height.

findingChanges.title: Bar support needs a closer surface check
findingChanges.change: Front squat uses a high-elbow underhand shoulder rack; Zercher shaft sits at the elbow cradle. Fine skin-to-shaft clearance still needs owner review.

findingChanges.title: Single-arm row support hand misses the bench
findingChanges.change: Fitted bench support palm and bent knee/shin for the non-working side.

findingChanges.title: Torso crunch is a rigid hip tilt
findingChanges.change: Added segmental trunk flexion; ball crunch retains its pelvis/ball contact instead of becoming an unsupported sit-up.

findingChanges.title: Plate hands pass through the plate
findingChanges.change: Plate front raise/halo use separated rim contacts; pinch carry has side-held plates.

findingChanges.title: Bench dip passes through the bench
findingChanges.change: Bench-dip support is at the front edge, with the pelvis descending in front.

findingChanges.title: Pendlay row lacks a settled floor start
findingChanges.change: Pendlay row reaches a floor-supported bar and includes a bottom reset dwell.

findingChanges.title: Zottman rotation changes abruptly
findingChanges.change: Zottman curl uses continuous top pronation and bottom return.

findingChanges.title: Around-the-world omits the hand transfer
findingChanges.change: Around-the-world alternates the working hand with front/back transfer points.

findingChanges.title: Anchored band floats without an anchor
findingChanges.change: Added actual fixed band stations and corrected cuff/hand endpoints.

findingChanges.title: Heel-elevated squat has no heel support
findingChanges.change: Added matched stable heel supports and heel-raised foot pitch.

findingChanges.title: Glute-drive machine is only a bench and generic frame
findingChanges.change: Added a glute-drive hip belt, foot platform, lever and supported upper back.

findingChanges.title: Single-leg ball bridge uses both feet on the ball
findingChanges.change: Single-leg ball bridge keeps the other leg lifted.

findingChanges.title: Trunk rotation is a diagonal chop
findingChanges.change: Trunk rotation follows a horizontal chest-height arc rather than a diagonal chop.

findingChanges.title: Machine pulldown lacks its referenced lever machine
findingChanges.change: Added plate-loaded overhead pivots, chest support and thigh restraint for the lever-pulldown illustration.

findingChanges.title: Supported single-arm raise has no support post
findingChanges.change: Added a fixed post at the leaning-raise support hand.

findingChanges.title: Leg-curl cuff and support do not match the standing setup
findingChanges.change: Standing leg curl uses a fitted ankle cuff, low cable and real support post, with a fixed knee path.

findingChanges.title: Band face-pull anchor and direction are incomplete
findingChanges.change: Face-pull band anchor is at upper-face height, with hands coming toward the temples.

findingChanges.title: Standing hip extension has no chair support
findingChanges.change: Standing hip extension now has a stable support at the free hand.

findingChanges.title: Knee hug lacks the travelling hand/leg sequence
findingChanges.change: Alternating knee hugs include measured hand-to-knee reaches; the loop remains in place.

findingChanges.title: Cross-body glute stretch reuses figure-four
findingChanges.change: Cross-body glute stretch has a distinct across-body knee setup, separate from figure-four.

findingChanges.title: Medicine-ball twist becomes a stability-ball exercise
findingChanges.change: Medicine-ball Russian twist remains seated with one hand-held medicine ball.

findingChanges.title: Toes-to-bar does not approach the bar
findingChanges.change: Raised toes approach the actual bar through a controlled leg arc.

findingChanges.title: Jump squat swings the dumbbells
findingChanges.change: Jump-squat dumbbells remain at the sides.

findingChanges.title: Skater squat lacks the rear-knee descent
findingChanges.change: Skater squat lowers the free knee behind the body toward a padded target.

limits: Engineering/source-configuration review of sampled illustrations; no clinical or professional certification.
Not a continuous replay of every source video.
Fine finger/skin collisions, manufacturer-specific dimensions, movement cadence and individual safe range still require human technique review.
Shared changes propagate to unreferenced drafts; all 446 clips have browser checks, but the 128 excluded source entries are not technique-cleared.
No real-account or physical-phone test; no database migration, production configuration change or live publication.
